description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news app, including tab navigation, app bar actions, drawers, and in-app navigation to various sections like saved news, notifications, and device token management.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that constructs the main home screen with tabs for different news categories, an app bar with actions, a drawer, and a body that shows content based on selected tab.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A simple class encapsulating the title and widget for each news category tab.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including AppBar, TabBar, TabBarView, and additional UI components based on the news app state.
